Luxury Towers

"True luxury is felt before it is seen. By orchestrating natural light, biophilic materials, acoustic serenity, and bespoke textural palettes, we transform structural volumes into soulful sanctuaries that enrich daily life."

Design Philosophy & Creative Leadership

Mrs. Prajakta Khade serves as the Creative Head & Interior Director at K Arch Architects, steering the studio's aesthetic identity, sensorial spatial planning, and high-end residential interior architecture.

Her holistic vision unites architecture and interiority, ensuring that a building's external geometry transitions effortlessly into warm, inviting, and functionally flawless interior experiences. From monumental double-height entrance lobbies for signature residential skyscrapers to intimate bespoke penthouses, Prajakta's designs are defined by impeccable craftsmanship, subtle lighting nuances, and tailored material curation.

Areas of Creative Specialization

Grand Entrance Lobbies

Monumental arrival experiences, custom acoustic paneling, water features, marble feature walls, and statement lighting design.

Biophilic Interior Styling

Incorporating natural greenery, organic daylight flows, non-toxic textures, and sustainable material palettes.

3D Spatial Visualization

Photorealistic 3D interior renders, material boards, VR walk-throughs, and lighting simulations for developer presentations.

Bespoke Penthouse Suites

Tailor-made luxury finishes, private terrace lounges, smart home automation integration, and artisanal millwork.
